title: hotel-booking-analysis
summary: A capstone project by a student group analyzing hotel booking data, including a data-preprocessing script that trains a synthetic data generator on the booking dataset. The script instantiates SingleTableMetadata and CTGANSynthesizer from sdv.single_table, fits it to the data, and samples synthetic rows, so SDV's CTGAN-based synthesizer is run directly to produce synthetic tabular data.
evidence: data-preprocessing/CTGAN.py: synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=500); synthesizer.fit(data); synthesizer.sample(num_rows=1000)
needs: industry classification is approximate; hospitality/travel domain not in allowed list
